name: Treasury Router
summary: Declares how explicitly deposited treasury funds are split between reserve, strategy, rewards and operations.
behavior: Configuration-only: the four shares must sum to 10,000 bps.
Enforced by the strategy vault when deposited funds are allocated.
verification: source in this repository; reproducible-build verification not yet published
limitations: Never touches Pump creator fees or protocol fees; it only describes funds a creator deposits explicitly.
The strategy-vault program that enforces the split is not yet deployed.
